result.summary: The screen is mostly clean, with no broken images or misaligned cards. The main visual defect is in the bottom navigation, where a system home-indicator bar overlaps the search icon. The bottom nav icons also lack text labels. Clipped carousel items and the cut-off card at the bottom were excluded as intended features.

issues.description: A black home-indicator bar is drawn over the bottom navigation bar, covering the search icon and crowding the bookmark icon. The search tab is partly obscured and looks broken.
issues.suggestion: Reserve bottom safe-area padding for the navigation bar so the system gesture indicator sits below the nav icons without overlapping them.

issues.description: Bottom navigation items (home, search, orders, profile) show icons only, with no visible text labels.
issues.suggestion: Add short text labels under each icon, or confirm that the icons are clearly recognizable and provide accessible names.
